title: PCSO Lotto Results: No winners of P349M Grand Lotto jackpot on Nov. 9
summary: No bettors took home the Grand Lotto 6/55 prize of over P349 million after no winners were announced in any of the major lotto jackpot draws on November 9, 2026, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes…

blocks.text: No bettors took home the Grand Lotto 6/55 prize of over P349 million after no winners were announced in any of the major lotto jackpot draws on November 9, 2026, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) said Monday.
The Grand Lotto jackpot of P349,051,462.79 was left unclaimed after no bettor played the winning numbers of 53-44-36-18-20-28.
There were also no correct guesses of the Megalotto 6/45 winning combination of 29-27-12-11-43-05. The prize would have been P15,000,000.
Check here for the complete lotto results. —RF, GMA News
